entities.summary: Awudu Abass Abass is an Italian professional basketball player for Dubai Basketball of the ABA League and the EuroLeague. Standing at 1.98 m, he plays at the small forward position. He has had a successful career in Italian basketball, winning the Italian League twice, winning the EuroCup, and playing for Cantu, Milano, Brescia and Bologna.
